articles.headline: Arkansas commissions review to improve football resources
articles.description: The University of Arkansas' board commissioned a review of the school's competitiveness in athletics and to identify steps to improve resources for its struggling football program Friday, a day before the 1-1 Razorbacks play host to No. 2 Georgia.

articles.headline: Judge allows case against ex-Bucknell coach to proceed
